name: Menu mountain wall colors
notes: Colors of the menu map's mountain wall (ts_menu_wall): 1 = the cave's black, 2-9 = the brown rock from its darkest crevices to its sunlit edges (close to the intro cave's own browns, since the cave leads there; 5-7 are also the cave's earth floor spilling out onto the grass), 10-14 = the meadow's greens (pal_ground_normal's grass, blade marks, deep, light and outline), for the tall grass at the foot of the wall and the lawn growing over the earth's edges.
